buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address HINDUSTAN AERONAUTICS LIMITED, BARRACKPORE 9 TOPKHANA ROAD BARRACKPORE NORTH 24 PARGANAS KOLKATA-700120 WEST BENGAL . 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Items to be procured from RCMA approved source only. Bidder have to submit valid RCMA approval co py along with the quotation. Otherwise, quotation will not be considered for further evaluation. Details o f items are as follows: Sl No. Part No. Part Description Qty. U/M Delivery requir ed 1 AHO-5 GEAR 600 Nos. 30 days ARO 2 AHO-41 DOME GLASS 123 Nos. 30 days ARO 3 AHM-05-05 GLASS 21 Nos. 30 days ARO 4 AHM-05-00A TAIL LIGHT 10 Nos. 30 days ARO LIGHT WARNING RH (G 5 AHM 06-00-02 6 Nos. 30 days ARO REEN). 6 AHM06-04 DOME GLASS (GREEN) 24 Nos. 30 days ARO 7 AHO-42 SEAL 6 Nos. 30 days ARO AHM06-05 8 GASKET 24 Nos. 30 days ARO 7007-98 Sl No. Technical Terms & Conditions The supplier should comply the following points: Inspection: Items will be cleared only after acceptance by the QC department 1 of HAL, Barrackpore Division. RCMA Approval: The supplier must provide a valid RCMA approval copy during 2 submission of the quotation and along with the supply of the items.

Certification: The supply must be accompanied by the Certificate of Conforman ce (CoC), original ink-signed or electronically signed, in HAL's prescribed forma 3 t. The CoC should include manufacturing batch details, unit serial numbers (if any) and any other relevant information. Packaging and Labelling: Items should be supplied in sealed packaging. Each package must clearly identify the part number, part description, quantity and b 4 atch details. Additionally, for shelf-life items (MPR line nos. 7 & 8), date of man ufacturing and date of expiration must be clearly mentioned in a sticker paste d on the packaging/ items. 5 Condition of Items: All supplied items must be new and unused. Warranty: The supplier should provide atleast one-year warranty certificate for 6 all items. Shelf Life: The supplier must ensure that shelf-life items (Seal & Gasket at ite 7 m sl nos. 7 & 8 above) have a minimum of 90% remaining shelf life at the time of shipment. Alternate Part Numbers: If an alternate part number is quoted, the supplier mu 8 st certify its complete interchangeability (form, fit & function) and provide sup porting documentation/descriptive literature. Delivery Schedule: The supplier should maintain projected delivery schedule t 9 o facilitate better utilization of the items. Sl No. Commercial Terms & Conditions 1 Validity of Quote (120 Days) 2 Delivery Terms (FOR HAL Barrackpore) Payment Terms: 100% Direct payment within 30 days after receipt and accept 3 ance of items at HAL Barrackpore. 4 LD clause accepted. (Yes/No) 5 Name of Contact person with phone no. & e-mail id 6 GST & PAN NO. Copy to be attached. 7 Bank Details. ECS mandate or cancelled cheque to be attached. 2) Bidder has put net total price including of GST for all the items mentioned above at appropriate financi al column at GeM. 3) For any further clarifications required on the tender, vendors may contact through email: gopal.barma n@hal-india.co.in, sudesh.kumar@hal-india.co.in or on 033-2540 2130 / 2037. .
